bio: The Montague on the Gardens hotel seems to inhabit two worlds. In front, is the British Museum and the hurly-burly of tourist London, just a stones throw from the West End theatre district and Covent Garden. To the rear, there's a serene private garden, cut off from the city by a rectangle of fine Georgian townhouses. Between the two lies The Montague - an intriguing blend of up-to-the-minute city vibrancy and old-world Bloomsbury calm.  The Traditional Afternoon Tea menu is a classic interpretation of the great British ritual featuring a range of finger sandwiches, scones and seasonal pastries made with only the finest of local produce.  A Children's Afternoon Tea is available from £24.50 per child. Treat your little ones to a whimsical wonderland of delicious treats and delightful surprises. From scrumptious jam and peanut butter sandwiches to mouthwatering cupcakes, it's an unforgettable experience that will leave them with a lasting sprinkle of joy. Served with a hot chocolate or a soft drink.  Enjoy Bottomless Afternoon Tea with 90 minutes of unlimited Lanson Le Black Reserve Brut NV Champagne and food for £160 per person.
